categoryTypes.title: Category types to crawl
categoryTypes.description: Which bold.org scholarship category families to crawl. Category pages are discovered from bold.org's sitemap, so no query-string URLs are ever requested. Ignored when you supply Start URLs.

maxCategoryPages.title: Max category pages
maxCategoryPages.description: How many category pages to fetch. Each page returns about 30 complete scholarship records in one request, so 20 pages is roughly 600 records before de-duplication.

maxResults.title: Max scholarships
maxResults.description: Stop after this many scholarships have been returned. This is also your cost cap: you are charged per returned scholarship only.

startUrls.title: Start URLs (optional)
startUrls.description: Specific bold.org URLs to scrape instead of sitemap-discovered categories. Accepts category pages (https://bold.org/scholarships/by-major/nursing-scholarships/) and individual scholarship pages (https://bold.org/scholarships/<slug>/). Do not include query strings — bold.org's robots.txt disallows them.

openOnly.title: Open scholarships only
openOnly.description: Skip scholarships whose deadline has already passed. Rolling-deadline scholarships are always kept.

minAwardAmount.title: Minimum award amount (USD)
minAwardAmount.description: Only return scholarships whose largest single award is at least this many dollars. Leave empty for no minimum.

deadlineAfter.title: Deadline after
deadlineAfter.description: Only return scholarships with a deadline on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

deadlineBefore.title: Deadline before
deadlineBefore.description: Only return scholarships with a deadline on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Useful for building 'closing this month' lists.

educationLevels.title: Education levels
educationLevels.description: Only return scholarships open to at least one of these levels. Leave empty for all levels.

includeEssayPrompt.title: Include essay prompt
includeEssayPrompt.description: Include the scholarship's essay question(s) as plain text in the essayTopic field.
